featured_reviews.name: Saleha Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited MMA Matrix yesterday to inquire about membership, as a close friend of mine is already a member there. Unfortunately, my experience with the manager at the front desk, ‘MR RAJESH’ was deeply disappointing.

From the moment I arrived, the interaction felt dismissive. The membership details were explained poorly and without any real effort to address my questions. What troubled me most, however, was when after barely 5 mins Mr. Rajesh approached me while I was looking at the equipment and gestured me toward the exit without further discussing the plan for joining, which was very rude.

As a trainer with a background in the service industry, I understand the standard of conduct that a client-facing role demands. This experience fell well short of that standard.

I hope this feedback reaches the right people and prompts a review of how prospective members are treated. First impressions matter enormously in this industry, and this one was, frankly, appalling.

featured_reviews.name: Mansoor Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
A very good place to work out. The gym ambience is great, and the gym is clean and neat.

However, one thing I noticed is that in other gyms where I previously had memberships, even if I had not taken personal training, the trainers would still guide or correct me if I was doing something wrong to help prevent injuries.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Dessus Fitness is hands down the best gym in the area! From the moment you step in, you can feel the positive energy and welcoming vibe. The gym culture here is truly unmatched—everyone, from the trainers to the members, is super motivating and supportive.

A special shoutout to Roshan and Aryasheel at the front desk! These guys are always friendly, professional, and ready to help with anything. Whether it’s guiding you through membership options or just making sure you have a great experience, they genuinely go above and beyond.

featured_reviews.review_text: I've been a happy member of Dessus Gym for a few months now. The gym is well-equipped, clean, and the staff is friendly and helpful. While I understand that celebrities may receive special treatment, it's important for the management to enforce policies equally for all members, regardless of their status. featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Tuba Javed Khanji

Pioneer Gym is perfect for anyone looking to build themselves up. I joined back in December 2023, and I plan to stay a member for a long time.

When I pick a gym, I look at the environment, the people, the management, the quality and maintenance of the equipment, and how open they are to feedback. Pioneer Gym checks all these boxes. I feel really comfortable with the friendly atmosphere and the people here. The machines are great, always well-maintained, and the management is fantastic. They genuinely care about the gym and its members, and they listen when we suggest changes.

I've seen real changes in myself because of the positive environment here. It motivates me to come back every day with enthusiasm. The trainers are amazing - they're like friends who support you, help you, and tell you when you're doing something wrong.

One great feature is the special designated time for ladies, so they can work out comfortably.

Only thing that can be improved is the crowd management, some days it is tolerable but there are days when you cannot train anything, other than that I would like if this gym had a water dispenser and a washroom as these two are a basic necessity in any gym. Overall a very good gym for beginners who have just started their journey in muscle building and a good gym in general as well.

featured_reviews.name: Arfat Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: As a member of Pioneer Gym, I commend Trainer Faisal sir and Trainer Shavez sir  for their exceptional expertise and strategic approach. featured_reviews.name: Pritul Sanghavi
featured_reviews.review_text: So I joined the gym one month back and wanted to experience the place before writing a review. This gym is one of the best in this area. featured_reviews.name: Rachith Poddar
featured_reviews.review_text: I’ve been coming to this gym for a while now, and I absolutely love it! The facilities are great, but what truly sets it apart is Ankit Gupta, the manager. featured_reviews.name: Jaskirat Suri
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a member since November 2023 and so far, I’ve really enjoyed my membership at this gym. The equipments are up to date and well maintained. Also the gym is open on all days throughout the week from 6am to 1 am which is very convenient as I can flexibly schedule my workouts around these timings.
I’ve enjoyed the additional services of steam as well which I find good for my muscle recovery.

Preeti at the desk is very sweet and is ready to assist incase of any queries.
Naseeb Bhai is an excellent trainer as well and I enjoyed my trial workout session under his guidance.

Would definitely recommend this gym to people around this area.
